agreements: Gearbox v1 VERIFIED_PASS and Step009 Heartbeat VERIFIED_FOUNDATION remain preserved; this review changes neither formal state nor executable code and does not claim C PASS.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect, wait, scheduler wake, window age, uptime and self-test duration are not Experience.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND must remain operational progress only and must never become verified Experience.
verified_progress_density is reason-only in current v2.1 and must remain observational until independently derived and anti-self-reinforcement tested.
Credit weights 5/4/3 and operational 1 are uncalibrated engineering heuristics only, not capability units or Trust/Identity/Personality/Governance/promotion truth.

Speed improvement is NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED; commit count, heartbeat count, wake count, window age, awake time and self-test duration are invalid substitutes for paired performance evidence.

disagreements.finding: Material new objection: v1 and inherited v2/v2.1 can legitimately output terminal control states N or R, and current v2.1 tests explicitly assert N/R outputs. However the next select_gear_v2 decision accepts current_gear only in G1..G6. Therefore the controller cannot faithfully round-trip its own terminal output into the next cycle; callers must falsify terminal residence as a G-state or fail validation, contaminating hysteresis/anti-thrash state and leaving N/R exit authority undefined.
disagreements.required_change: Replace current_gear with one canonical current-control-state boundary accepting N/R/G1..G6 from a trusted monotonic runtime-state receipt. Define authenticated terminal-exit transitions: R cannot move to Gx through ordinary secretary/pressure/anti-thrash telemetry, and N can leave standby only through an explicit trusted terminal-exit authority.

disagreements.finding: v1 evaluates standby before rollback, so simultaneous standby+rollback resolves by branch order; v2 can also overwrite inherited N/R with G1 on recovery_active, anchor failure or RED secretary.
disagreements.required_change: Define versioned structural terminal-authority precedence before nonterminal routing; trusted R cannot be overwritten, and N exits only through explicit trusted terminal-exit authority.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh remains caller-declared; literal true can label stale secretary telemetry fresh, while secretary-derived numeric pressure fields can still affect routing after secretary_level is neutralized.
disagreements.required_change: Use replay-resistant SecretarySignalEnvelope plus per-field provenance/freshness; stale/conflicting secretary-derived fields contribute zero routing pressure unless independently fresh and trusted.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict=true only neutralizes secretary_level; it does not load, validate or enforce the actual fresh authority decision.
disagreements.required_change: Project an exact trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope or fail closed; permissive caller fallback must not substitute for fresh authority.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum sample, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis; 1/1 can appear as 100 percent thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive shift rate from canonical append-only shift history with precommitted support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release; thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while delaying a safe necessary upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown; lower shift count alone is not success.

disagreements.finding: verified_progress_density is reason-only now, but because it is caller-supplied it would become self-reinforcing if connected directly to routing authority.
disagreements.required_change: Keep observational until independently derived from accepted evidence and tested against feedback-loop amplification.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events uses only a per-invocation seen set and str-coerced event_id. Same evidence can be replayed under new IDs or across restart/rollback, and rejected claims can reserve identity before acceptance.
disagreements.required_change: Use typed EventIdentity plus durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry. Exact accepted replay NO_OPs; same-ID/different-binding is IDENTITY_CONFLICT; rejected claims do not reserve identity.

disagreements.finding: Public Gearbox v2 still places DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND in EXPERIENCE_WEIGHTS with positive weight 1 and exports the result through experience_candidate_delta, while v2.1 requires these classes to be operational-only.
disagreements.required_change: Use one shared authoritative classifier with separate verified_experience_delta and operational_progress_delta; legacy v2 Experience-labelled operational credit must be deprecated or explicitly non-authoritative.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience lacks mandatory exact evidence hash and trusted C/independent-verifier identity/receipt.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable exact evidence identity plus trusted verifier acceptance receipt and bind it to canonical verification stage before any authoritative verified credit exists.

disagreements.finding: v2 gates real Experience on C_VERIFIED, but v2.1 re-mints verified_experience_delta from raw event_kind plus event_independently_verified without applying the inherited verification-stage gate.
disagreements.required_change: Use one authority path: exact evidence -> trusted C/independent-verifier receipt -> canonical verification eligibility -> immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt -> v2/v2.1 projection.

disagreements.finding: Weights 5/4/3 for verified classes and 1 for operational classes are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No exact-current paired evaluation establishes speedup, and metric definitions must be frozen so baseline/candidate cannot differ in wake denominator, observation window, censoring, workload coverage or rework/rollback semantics.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/randomized crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, one versioned canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency with identical metric manifest and equal-or-better verification/risk quality.

statistical_risks: Terminal-state residence cannot currently be represented faithfully across decision cycles because N/R outputs cannot be supplied as next-cycle current_gear; any forced G-state substitution biases hysteresis, shift-rate and recovery measurements.
Terminal authority conflicts can be misclassified as ordinary routing behavior when branch order, not a versioned authority rule, determines N versus R and v2 overlays can rewrite terminal outcomes.
Caller-declared secretary freshness and incomplete authority projection invalidate causal routing comparisons.
Small-n caller-supplied shift-rate estimates can false-trigger anti-thrash or chatter around the threshold.
Anti-thrash may improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle, closure or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density can become self-reinforcing if fed back into routing authority.
Transient event identity, same-evidence/new-ID replay and raw-field credit paths can inflate longitudinal Experience/progress totals.
Cross-version operational/Experience semantic disagreement contaminates longitudinal totals and capability correlations.
Cross-layer verification-stage disagreement can count verified credit in v2.1 for events that v2 marks NOT_PROMOTION_EVIDENCE.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.

Speed metrics require matched paired/crossover evaluation with a frozen versioned metric manifest and complete assigned-workload accounting; self-test duration is diagnostic cost, not speedup evidence.
proposed_tests: GB21-TERMINAL-ROUNDTRIP-362: obtain N and R from one decision, then feed each exact terminal state into the next decision as canonical current control state; both must be accepted without falsifying to a G-state.

GB21-TERMINAL-EXIT-AUTHORITY-363: current state R/N cannot transition to Gx without a trusted terminal-exit authority; secretary, pressure, recovery heuristics or anti-thrash alone cannot authorize exit.
GB21-TERMINAL-ANTI-THRASH-364: current state N/R bypasses numeric G-gear anti-thrash parsing and remains visible in shift/recovery statistics as terminal residence, not a substituted G-state.
GB21-TERMINAL-CONFLICT-365: standby=true plus rollback_required=true resolves through a precommitted versioned terminal-authority rule, independent of if-statement order.
GB21-SECRETARY-FRESHNESS-FORGE-366: stale RED/ORANGE plus forged freshness=true and stale numeric pressure cannot route without trusted per-field provenance/freshness binding.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-367: fresh authority=G1/recovery with permissive caller fallback still produces the trusted authority result.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-SMALL-N-368: 1/1 and 2/3 samples cannot trigger calibrated anti-thrash without precommitted minimum support; test entry/exit hysteresis around the threshold.
GB21-ANTI-THRASH-PERF-NR-369: lower shift rate is rejected as improvement if cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency regresses.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-NULL-370: forged high verified_progress_density remains observational and cannot upshift or create credit.
GB21-EVENT-LINEAGE-REPLAY-371: same evidence under 10000 new IDs plus exact-ID restart/rollback replay produces one authoritative acceptance only.
GB21-OPERATIONAL-SEMANTIC-372: v2 and v2.1 classify DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND consistently as operational-only in authoritative outputs.
GB21-VERIFIED-RECEIPT-BINDING-373: verified event without exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt yields zero authoritative verified Experience.
GB21-V21-STAGE-CONSISTENCY-374: UNVERIFIED/CANDIDATE/BUILT_NOT_VERIFIED cannot produce authoritative v2.1 verified credit without exact trusted eligibility receipt; v2/v2.1 share one gate.
GB21-CREDIT-NON-EQUIVALENCE-375: equal aggregate heuristic scores from different event mixtures are not equal capability or promotion evidence.

GB21-SPEED-PAIRED-BASELINE-376: sealed matched AB/BA or randomized crossover uses durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency with identical versioned metric manifest, assigned-workload coverage and terminal-state accounting.

blocks: claim that N/R terminal state has a closed-loop current-state representation and authenticated exit semantics
claim that terminal N/R precedence is structurally enforced
claim that secretary freshness or fresh-authority precedence is executable from current caller booleans
claim that anti-thrash is calibrated or performance-safe from current caller-supplied shift ratio
authoritative verified Experience accounting from current raw-field paths
claim that DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND have one consistent operational-only semantic across public v2 and v2.1
speedup or capability claims from raw credit totals, commits, wakes, heartbeat count, window age, uptime or self-test duration

release_condition: Fresh exact-current v1+v2+v2.1 executable regression evidence exists on the same candidate bytes; historical results are not promoted as fresh PASS.

Terminal control is closed-loop and versioned: canonical current-control-state accepts N/R/G1..G6 from trusted monotonic runtime-state evidence; simultaneous standby+rollback resolves through a canonical rule; trusted R cannot be rewritten by nonterminal overlays; N/R exit requires authenticated terminal-exit authority.
Fresh-authority decisions and secretary telemetry use trusted replay-resistant envelopes with per-field provenance/freshness; stale/conflicting secretary-derived fields have zero routing effect.
recent_shift_rate_ratio is derived from canonical shift history with precommitted numerator/denominator, minimum support, observation window, uncertainty and stateful enter/exit hysteresis.
Anti-thrash passes paired non-regression for cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour and recovery_latency; lower shift count alone is insufficient.
verified_progress_density remains observational unless independently derived and anti-self-reinforcement tested.
EventIdentity and evidence lineage are durable, rollback-resistant and exactly-once across restart; same evidence under new IDs cannot re-credit and rejected claims do not reserve identity.
v2/v2.1 share one authoritative classifier separating verified Experience from operational progress; DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are operational-only.
Verified Experience requires exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier identity and immutable acceptance receipt bound to canonical verification eligibility.
Credit weights remain documented as uncalibrated engineering heuristics and are excluded from capability/Trust/Identity/Personality/Governance/promotion truth claims.

Speedup is demonstrated only by sealed matched paired/randomized-crossover evidence over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, one canonical versioned rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency, with identical metric manifest, complete assigned-workload accounting, terminal-state residence accounting and equal-or-better verification/risk quality.
Dedicated fresh Spirit review and current Navigator synthesis reach zero release-blocking veto before any normal A->B->C formal route is considered.
